listing.name: Shadow of the Colossus — 2018 PS4 remake (ShadowOfTheColossus-PC)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream runtime package for ShadowOfTheColossus-PC; use own game files per documented setup, with upstream/player owning installation and runtime replacement. Observed release artifacts are evidence, not operational package selection or Portcove support. Limits: Upstream only: Upstream claims ending/credits. AMD fix not confirmed on physical hardware; no Portcove playthrough or inherited fork qualification. Primary parent for row37 optimized fork. Upstream start-to-end claim; AMD fixes not physically tested. Compare existing PS4 runtime ownership, not PS2/PS3 editions. Upstream platforms: Windows10/11 PS4 layer, EU CUSA08809v1.01. US support belongs to Oussama fork; own console audio modules required. Original data: Own PS4 ShadowOfColossus Bluepoint2018 EU CUSA08809v1.01 game dump with eboot.bin,sce_module,sce_sys. Sound requires owner-dumped decrypted libSceNgs2.sprx and libSceUlt.sprx; silent without them. Modules are Sony firmware, excluded from package. US support belongs to Oussama fork extension, not established for parent. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
